rules: Answering all questions for a dimension does NOT automatically set RESOLVED.
EVIDENCE_REQUIRED applies when entry state 01+ claims equity without upload.
INTERPRETATION_READY means SITE 00 may synthesize; client answers alone are insufficient for VERBAL_SYSTEM final lines.
LOCKED requires authority dimension approval and evidence for claimed equity.
CONFLICTED preserves tension; do not flatten contradictory client signals.
BUILD_READY (03) verification may reclassify dimensions to EVIDENCE_REQUIRED or CONFLICTED.
